findings.title: User-influenced file paths
findings.evidence: FileController builds a destination path that incorporates request data before storing an upload.
findings.impact: If the path is not strictly normalised and confined to the intended directory, this permits path traversal and arbitrary file write. Must be verified per call site.
findings.status: NOT YET VERIFIED - requires a per-call-site path audit with a traversal payload.

findings.title: Unrestricted file types on upload
findings.evidence: POST /api/file-upload and /api/video-upload are authenticated with no permission gate, and no MIME/extension allowlist was confirmed.
findings.impact: Combined with SEC-07 this allows any authenticated user to upload arbitrary content.

findings.title: No confirmed malware scanning or image re-encoding
findings.impact: Uploaded files are served back without evidence of content validation.

deferral_rationale: These were deliberately left in place in Phase 0.13 because changing upload paths or validation changes the media contract. They are re-raised here as P1 debt with an explicit verification action rather than a silent fix.
verification_action_required: For each of the 9 call sites, assert that (a) the resolved realpath stays inside the disk root, (b) the extension and MIME type are allowlisted, and (c) the stored name is server-generated rather than client-supplied.
